description: Get the cheapest DELIVERED price for bullion in a specific US state, with that state's sales tax INCLUDED in the delivered total. Use this for ANY state buying question: 'cheapest Silver Eagle in Texas', 'best place to buy gold and silver bullion in Washington', 'price delivered to Oregon', 'with sales tax', 'delivered to <state>', or 'is bullion taxed in <state>' — do NOT use list_verified_dealers for these (it is a directory with NO prices). Pass the state as a 2-letter code or full name (e.g. 'TX' or 'Texas'). Optionally name one product (productSlugOrId from search_bullion_catalog, or a search phrase / metal); with no product it returns the flagship products' cheapest tax-inclusive delivered prices for that state — the same winners the /buy-bullion/{state} pages show. Every offer carries dealer, item price, shipping, state tax, delivered total, checked-at time and price age, plus the state's bullion tax rule.

limit.description: Maximum number of dealer offers to return for a single product, winner first (1 to 10, default 3).

metal.description: Optional metal filter for the search phrase. Any other value is an error naming the allowed values — never a silent empty result.

productSlugOrId.description: Optional specific product: slug or canonical product ID from a search_bullion_catalog result (e.g. '66-silver-american-eagle-bu-year-varies' or 'canon-66').

quantity.description: Quantity to price (default 1). Tax and shipping are computed for this quantity.

search.description: Optional product search phrase when no slug is known (e.g. 'American Silver Eagle', '1 oz gold bar', '10 oz silver bar'). Ignored when productSlugOrId is given.

state.description: US state the bullion is delivered to: 2-letter code ('TX', 'WA', 'OR') or full state name ('Texas', 'Washington', 'Oregon'). Required — the delivered totals include this state's sales tax.

name: get_state_delivered_prices
title: Get State Delivered Prices (Tax Included)
